description.zh:
指定要查询的容器集群的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the container cluster to query.
> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
The query condition of the baseline.

description.zh:
要查询的基线的查询类型。取值：

- **BaselineNameAlias**：基线名称

- **BaselineClassAlias**：基线分类
description.en:
The query type of the baselines to query. Valid values:

- **BaselineNameAlias**: baseline name

- **BaselineClassAlias**: baseline category.

description.zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。起始值为**1**。默认值为**1**，表示从第1页开始显示。
description.en: The page number to display from the returned results. Minimum value: **1**. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is displayed.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language type for requests and responses. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的数据的最大条数。默认值为**20**。
description.en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **20**.

description.zh:
要查询的基线的风险等级。多个等级用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：

- **high**：高危

- **medium**：中危

- **low**：低危
description.en:
The risk level of the baselines to query. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). Valid values:

- **high**: high risk

- **medium**: medium risk

- **low**: low risk.

title.zh: 查询镜像安全扫描的镜像基线检查列表
title.en: Query image baseline check list for image security scans

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-image-baseline-check-summary --risk-level high --criteria Unauthorized_access --criteria-type BaselineNameAlias --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --lang zh --cluster-id c60b77fe62093480db6164a3c2fa50000 --scan-range container --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeImageBaselineCheckSummary --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --CurrentPage 1 --ClusterId c60b77fe62093480db6164a3c2fa50000 --CriteriaType BaselineNameAlias --Lang zh --Criteria Unauthorized_access --ScanRange.1 container --RiskLevel high
